_note: Set B, VERSIONED WITH THE RULES (12 files: top p1..p8, bottom p1..p4). tableVersion 1234-1 — the BOTTOM p3/p4 rows re-pin from 1223-1 for #1234 (an overrun point takes the height at the posted position): raw cut-into 0.0241 → 0, adjudicated 0, the >1 mm band unchanged, links re-derived after the overrun tails moved, cycle 16,900 → 16,925 s. TOP p1..p8 and BOTTOM p1/p2 are byte-identical to 1223-1. 1223-1's own note follows: the combined tray-top re-pin. TOP rows re-pin from 1214-1 (their bytes were still 1195-1's): the planner stack (#1217's leftover tolerance, #1224's ruling, #1219's feed-row step-over), #1227's 0.001 ring inset and #1223's lobe order changed p1..p6; p7 and p8 are byte-identical. BOTTOM rows re-pin from 1214-1: #1214's F words and TIME as before, then the planner stack splits out a NEW ⌀0.9 flat program at p2, so the finish and rest keep their bytes as p3/p4 and p1's rough/pocket is re-planned (1 h 26 min). Per-file old→new and the issue each movement belongs to are in changedSince1223. The e2e reads this table as the cross-door check.
rule: (a) A CANDIDATE CHAIN IS RANKED BY THE TIME IT WILL REALLY TAKE (#1186 rule 1), ties to fewer bit changes then owned; (b) EVERY FLAT MAY PROPOSE AS A PRIMARY, shortlisted to the incumbent and the best own-row flat (#1192), and a cutter that can FREE the profile always joins when none shortlisted can (#1195); (c) THE FREEING CONTOUR IS A HARD CONSTRAINT (#1195, the analyst’s field): no chain is a candidate without a cutter whose STATED flute reaches the profile’s actual posted depth; the pick refuses only when nothing owned reaches or the operator pinned a cutter that does not, with a named sentence; (d) ONE CUTTER PER SHAPE AND DIAMETER, only on a job with a setup boundary (#1186 rule 6, gated by the setup count).
source: casemaker cut <job>.cutjob.json --location ~/setb-inputs/location.json --catalogue ~/setb-inputs/catalogue.json, branch 1195-freeing-reach @ 9338152b2 (1186-bench + the setup-boundary gate + #1195), k3, 2026-11-10; the CLI output is byte-identical to tableVersion 1114-1
